limitations: Snapshot prices are estimated advertised minima, not representative averages or confirmed bookable fares.
Route minima may mix airline types, carriers, trip lengths and nonstop/connecting flights.
Quotes from the 2026-10/2027-03 horizon calibrate the synthetic 2026 dataset; they are not historical 2026 observations.
Korean Air daily quotes vary in return date and trip length, so descriptive weekday medians do not identify a causal weekday effect.
GMP-origin Osaka quotes were excluded from the ICN model.
The existing airline-route map, fixed costs, seasonal and holiday factors remain simulation assumptions.

notes: All coefficients in model are assumptions, not fitted route-specific Korean-Japan statistical estimates.
The 25% uplift converts a lowest advertised fare into a neutral simulation baseline, not a measured average.
Weekday patterns are normalized to mean 1 and applied only to variable fare; actual calendar weekdays are never rotated by city.
Outbound and return fares use their own date's weekday; independent sale days can still be cheapest on any weekday.
ALL-route minima approximate LCC anchors where the existing route map has LCC service.
FSC anchors use Korean Air monthly minima when available, otherwise the route minimum plus the estimated premium if LCC is present.

sources.title: Google Flights 2026 holiday travel trends
sources.scope: US departure analysis; directional context only, not Korean-Japan calibration percentages.

sources.title: Expedia 2026 Air Hacks
sources.scope: US booking population; a different cheapest departure day, so no universal rule is assumed.

sources.scope: Qualitative weekday/weekend and outbound/return flexibility guidance.
